        - heading "Understand Eliminate Variables" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Eliminate variables removes one variable to make a smaller system. In Eliminate Variables, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. You can learn Eliminate Variables by trying one small example instead of long theory.
        - paragraph: Combine equations so one variable cancels. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
